scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @dargaze/shared && concurrently -k -n API,CLIENT -c red,cyan "npm:dev --workspace @dargaze/server" "npm:dev --workspace @dargaze/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @dargaze/shared && npm run build --workspace @dargaze/server && npm run build --workspace @dargaze/client
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @dargaze/shared && npm run test --workspace @dargaze/shared && npm run test --workspace @dargaze/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @dargaze/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @dargaze/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @dargaze/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @dargaze/client
